tasks.short: Prepare or review geological sampling, testing and analysis reports.

steps.what: Verify actual sample, test and analysis results and their source metadata
inputs: actual sample/test owner results and source records
actual reporting scope
outputs: checked report results, sample ids, methods, units and qualifications

steps.what: Prepare fixed sampling and testing report tables from checked result fields
inputs: checked report results, sample ids, methods, units and qualifications

steps.what: Write report explanations from actual checked findings and technician-chosen recommendations
inputs: traceable fixed geological report tables
checked report results, sample ids, methods, units and qualifications
actual technician interpretations and recommendations

loop.purpose: Draft descriptive geological report prose from actual checked findings
loop.input: checked results, actual interpretations, recommendations and qualifications
loop.output: complete source-linked report narrative without inferred recommendations
loop.check: Technician checks meaning, omitted sampling qualifications, numeric attribution and invented certainty or recommendations
loop.stop: Missing result provenance or two failed revisions returns affected prose to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native fixed report sections first; varied findings and qualifications require semantic checks

steps.what: Review and complete the whole geological report against actual evidence and recommendations
inputs: complete geological report draft
checked report results, sample ids, methods, units and qualifications
outputs: complete checked final internal geological report

steps.what: Save the checked geological report in its ordinary internal report workspace
inputs: complete checked final internal geological report

tasks.design: Configure fixed result tables in {DOCS} from checked fields in the actual geological sample/test application, OTHER; use bounded drafting only for descriptive narrative. Retain actual interpretation and recommendations, complete source and final checks, and fully retained ungated ordinary saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report tables and descriptive explanations can be prepared repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native table generation and source-grounded drafting can reduce assembly and typing.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling limitations and interpretation require actual geological judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician preserves an uncertainty that changes how a finding should be used.
tasks.altitude: Reduce fixed report assembly and selected descriptive typing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed test-result tables and bounded source-grounded report prose can assist technical reporting.

assumptions: Provisional table20 is manual field/table assembly, not instrument runtime or same-system saving; narrative30 removes three descriptive typing points after retained semantic review. Actual test/sample owner supplies result, id, method, units and provenance; technician extracts/verifies missing source information within25 and supplies real interpretation within retained narrative27. Missing structured fields stay manual.

Final whole-report check24 remains and ordinary save1 remains ungated. Existing report generation gets zero new credit. This prepares/reviews an internal report; it does not invent client transmission, certification or independent approval work.
unknowns: How much table assembly is already native?
research_questions: Do output tables preserve methods, units and actual result qualifications?

incremental.description: Maintain report field mappings and narrative source/qualification checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 table-assembly plus3 descriptive typing points minus1 upkeep=22. Low: inconsistent output metadata requires manual table work and most new narrative, leaving5 compatible table points and1 routine descriptive point removable, minus1=5. Source validation, real interpretation, whole checks and save remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study reports and compile geological and geophysical prospecting information.

steps.what: Read and study actual geological reports and identify relevant prospecting information
inputs: actual prospecting question and source reports
outputs: selected source passages and actual geological interpretation

steps.what: Extract selected report facts with source pages, location context and geological qualifications
inputs: selected source passages and actual geological interpretation

loop.purpose: Propose fact entries from technician-selected actual report passages
loop.input: actual selected report pages and chosen compilation fields
loop.check: Technician checks actual passage meaning, units, location, omissions and whether historical statements were presented as current observations
loop.stop: Unreadable source or two failed revisions returns affected entries to manual extraction
loop.why_not_simpler: Try native report tables/search first; varied narrative qualifications need semantic extraction checks

steps.what: Compile checked geological and geophysical entries into the prospecting information table
inputs: checked source-linked prospecting fact entries
outputs: complete prospecting compilation with source references

steps.what: Check complete prospecting information for comparability and retain the actual internal compilation
inputs: complete prospecting compilation with source references
selected source passages and actual geological interpretation

tasks.design: After actual reading and source selection, propose source-linked entries from selected passages in {DOCS} and configure their compilation in {SPREADSHEET}. Keep geological reading, interpretation, field checks and complete comparability review; ordinary internal saving stays ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected report facts and references can be typed into a compilation repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded passage extraction plus native compilation can reduce selected typing and assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Historical geology, spatial context and contradictory reports need actual interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The technician distinguishes a report's hypothesis from its actual observation.
tasks.altitude: Reduce selected source-entry typing and compilation assembly.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked passage extraction can assist report compilation when actual meaning is checked.

assumptions: Provisional extraction25 removes five typing points while retaining20 source/meaning checks; compilation25 removes five fixed field/reference assembly points. Actual reading/source selection40 and complete final review10 remain. Source report author/page is the producer; extraction is counted in its own25 step, not a free structured input.

Missing units, unreadable scans and conflicting locations stay manual. No automatic geological inference or resource estimate is assumed. Existing extraction/templates get zero new credit. Ordinary internal save remains within fully retained final review, with no gate or saving.
unknowns: How much selected source content is legible and comparable?
research_questions: Can extraction preserve negative findings and report-specific qualifications?

incremental.description: Maintain extraction fields and audit source meaning and compilation provenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 selected fact-typing and5 compilation assembly points minus1 upkeep=9. Low: conflicting legacy descriptions need manual extraction and comparison, leaving only1 source-reference typing and1 compatible compilation-layout point removable, minus1=1. Reading, interpretation, source checks and complete comparability checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview individuals and research public databases for geological information.

steps.what: Interview actual individuals and capture their statements, uncertainty and source context
inputs: actual information need and interviewees
outputs: actual technician-captured interview notes and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write and check the actual interview information record from captured notes
inputs: actual technician-captured interview notes and unresolved questions

steps.what: Research actual public databases using current location, subject and date filters
inputs: actual information need and study location
actual public database fields and current metadata
outputs: checked relevant public database findings and source metadata

steps.what: Write and check combined findings with interview and public-source qualifications
inputs: checked actual interview information record
checked relevant public database findings and source metadata

tasks.design: Configure reusable actual location/subject filters in the existing public database views, {DATA_PLATFORM}. Retain actual interviews and note capture, fresh interview records, source interpretation and combined findings; ordinary internal saves stay ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Public database location and subject queries can be rebuilt repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved filters can reduce repeated query setup.
tasks.still_hard: Interview reliability and relevance of public information need actual judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician follows up a local account that conflicts with a published record.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native saved database filters can reduce repeated public information searches.

assumptions: Provisional database15 removes three repeated filter/navigation points, retaining12 relevance/metadata checks. Database owner supplies actual fields, coverage dates and source metadata; technician chooses actual location/subject and investigates missing records manually. No new extraction or free transcript assumed.

Interview60 includes real capture; distinct record15 and combined findings10 retain their actual writing/checking. No extra report or send is invented beyond this information account; if no written account is owned, remove/reweight it. Existing saved queries get zero credit.
unknowns: Which database queries are actually repeated for this work?

incremental.description: Maintain public query coverage and field definitions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 public query-setup points minus0.4 upkeep=2.6. Low: a new prospecting area has sparse public coverage and requires manual source research, leaving only0.8 familiar database-navigation point removable, minus0.4=0.4. Interviews, capture, records and actual interpretation remain.

tasks.short: Plot geological information from photographs, well logs, sections and databases.

steps.what: Verify actual photograph, well-log, section or database coordinates, units and source revisions
inputs: actual geological source material and coordinate metadata
actual plotting scope
outputs: checked selected geological observations and spatial metadata

steps.what: Plot compatible verified geological observations using checked coordinate and symbol mappings
inputs: checked selected geological observations and spatial metadata
actual chosen map projection, scale and symbol mappings
outputs: traceable draft geological plot and explicit incompatible-source exceptions

steps.what: Interpret actual features, resolve georeferencing problems and check plotted geological relationships
inputs: traceable draft geological plot and explicit incompatible-source exceptions
actual geological source material and coordinate metadata
outputs: checked corrected geological plot with actual interpretation and unresolved limits

steps.what: Complete and check plot legends, source references and limitations and retain the internal map
inputs: checked corrected geological plot with actual interpretation and unresolved limits

tasks.design: Configure checked coordinate and symbol mappings in the actual geological GIS application, OTHER, to plot compatible already verified observations. Retain actual source extraction/verification, feature interpretation, georeferencing corrections and complete map checks; ordinary internal save is ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compatible coordinates and symbols can be plotted manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native GIS mappings can plot selected checked observations deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Photo interpretation, log correlation and incompatible historical layers require geological judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician finds that a mapped boundary reflects coordinate error rather than geology.
tasks.altitude: Reduce manual plotting of compatible checked observations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native GIS coordinate/symbol mappings can plot verified compatible observations while geological interpretation remains human.

assumptions: Provisional plot25 is actual manual coordinate/symbol plotting, not existing GIS runtime. Source owner supplies actual photograph/log/section id, revision, depth/coordinate units and reference system; technician performs actual selection, extraction, validation and mapping choice within30. Missing coordinates and unreadable sources remain manual; no free feature extraction.
Georeferencing and interpretation30 plus full final map15 remain. Existing imports/plots receive no new credit. No public map publication or approval of an author's ordinary save is invented.
unknowns: Which actual sources have compatible verified coordinates?
research_questions: Can plotting stop on incompatible depth or coordinate reference systems?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes25 manual plotting points minus1.2 upkeep=23.8. Source capture, geological interpretation, corrections and full final map checks remain.
